description: Generate original fantasy names for characters and places — male, female, and location styles with short, medium, or long forms.

faqs.a: No — every name is built on the spot from original syllable banks, so you get fresh combinations, not copied characters.
faqs.q: Are these names from books or games?

faqs.a: Yes. Choose 1, 10, or 25 names per click for brainstorming whole casts or maps.
faqs.q: Can I generate many names at once?

faqs.a: Click any generated name (or its Copy button) to copy it to your clipboard instantly.
faqs.q: How do I copy a name?

howto: Pick a style: male, female, or place.
Choose name length and how many to generate.
Press Generate, then tap any name to copy it.
title: Fantasy Name Generator
